verses.1: If it had not been Jehovah who was on our side, Let Israel now say,
verses.2: If it had not been Jehovah who was on our side, When men rose up against us;
verses.3: Then they had swallowed us up alive, When their wrath was kindled against us:
verses.4: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, The stream had gone over our soul;
verses.5: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
verses.6: Blessed be Jehovah, Who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
verses.7: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: The snare is broken, and we are escaped.
verses.8: Our help is in the name of Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.
